test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Direction: Select the option 'no correction required’ if the sentence is correct as given.**

The dessert was not just extremely hot but** (also to sweet as well)**.
solution:
Here, the correct answer is **"also too sweet."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error in the sentence is in the use of** "to**" instead of** "too" **in the phrase **"to sweet."**
 
• The correct word is** "too,"** indicating an excessive degree. 
 
• This version maintains consistency and uses the correct form of** "too" **to convey the idea of excessive sweetness.
 
• We must remove the redundant **"as well" **at the end of the sentence.
 
• The use of **"too"** already indicates excess, so **"as well"** is unnecessary.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

Correct sentence: *The dessert was not just extremely hot but **also too sweet**__.*
